title: Deeper/broader cross-project DXF writer and DIMENSION group-type review
scope: Cross-check recent open-source DXF/DWG writer and parser failure reports against existing plan owners
Audit DIMENSION group-code 80-84 type use across authoritative references, an independent typed model, and local writer callsites
Refine PAR-39/7X implementation readiness without changing code, tests, fixtures, dependencies, or support claims

sources.title: Autodesk Group Code Value Types Reference
sources.finding: Lists 60-79 as 16-bit and 90-99 as 32-bit; no general type assignment for 80-89.

sources.title: Autodesk Common Dimension Group Codes
sources.finding: Common DIMENSION group-code list does not include 80-84.

sources.title: ezdxf Dimension entity source
sources.finding: Independent typed common-DIMENSION attributes omit codes 80-84; not a normative exclusion.

sources.title: ACadSharp issue 1253
sources.finding: Reporter describes AutoCAD rejection of a peer DXF writer with CLASSES, HATCH, and DIMSTYLE table-scope issues; peer report only.

sources.title: LibreDWG issue 1410
sources.finding: Reporter describes peer DXF-to-DWG failures around zero-valued HATCH coordinates, ATTRIB tags, and embedded MTEXT; existing local plan coverage applies.

sources.title: ezdxf binary proxy issue 1412 and fix 1418
sources.finding: Peer-specific raw-binary versus pre-encoded-hex proxy transport defect; merged fix already mapped to existing local chunk coverage.

sources.title: Autodesk About Binary DXF Files
sources.finding: Distinguishes scalar widths, NUL-terminated strings, binary chunks, two-byte group codes, and the 0xFF extended-code escape.

observations: The standalone DXF classifier maps group codes 80-89 to String.
Both DIMENSION writer paths call writeInt16() for nonzero 80-84 fields.
The guarded binary writeInt16 path requires the code's classified kind to be I16 and therefore rejects these calls.
The ASCII writeInt16 path validates numeric range but does not validate the group's assigned kind.
Git history traces the fields to LibreCAD parity import commit 0c5595930b20917a40ed7c188475eaca624b8ce9; this establishes local source lineage, not format semantics.
A read-only scan of all 16 checked-in ASCII DXF fixtures found no DIMENSION groups 80-84.
No end-to-end generated execution was run during this research-only update.
localAudit.classification: Source-confirmed caller/classifier mismatch under the existing PAR-39 umbrella; the legal semantics/profile for codes 80-84 remain unresolved.

validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check for the edited plan; jq empty validates the research receipt
